overview.description: The RiverNorth Market Neutral ETF (RNMN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is an actively managed asset allocation fund that holds a combination of SPACs, equities, ADRs, FLEX options, corporate bonds, and swaps. It seeks total return while limiting correlation to the equity markets. RNMN was launched on Jul 11, 2022 and is issued by Truemark Group.
